generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch MY2025 (Grand Touring, Dream Edition), Touring from 2026. First non-Tesla with a native NACS port. Grand Touring/Dream: 123 kWh, 926 V, up to 400 kW DC; Touring: ~89 kWh, ~300 kW. On 500 V Superchargers peak drops to ~225 kW. No NRCan rows in our import. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.wardsauto.com/news/2025-lucid-gravity-450-miles-of-range-and-nacs-port/799062/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/779545/cheaper-lucid-gravity-touring-price-range-charging/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/757998/lucid-gravity-fast-charging-interview/
